# Direction B: Order ticket

- Anchor: utilitarian (a deliberately utilitarian register)
- Concrete reference: a trading desk's order ticket.

## Token plan

- Type roles: display system-ui, body system-ui, mono ui-monospace.
- Signature element: the withdrawal ticket shows its block height and settles in place.

## Rationale and trade-off

- Why this direction fits the brief: the people who queue withdrawals work in dense tools all day.
- What it costs: dense screens need the H1 to be short to read from a projector.
